description:
Loved talking with Curtis Matsko about what it took to scale Portland Leather Goods from a garage operation to a $120M+on DTC brand on pace to make more than 2 million bags in 2023. 

In this clip, he's talking about big ideas and how to make them a reality, even when the people around you don't think those ideas are good. 

Want access to the full interview? Visit http://retention.com/22
